title: Quick table
note: Tables run on the game server; every player verifies each hand. Share the table code by any chat app.

create.title: Create a table
create.body: The server deals and referees, so no player can see the wall. Empty seats can be filled with bots.

devServer: Game server: %{url}. Development builds can change it in Settings.

errors.alreadySeated: Your account already has a seat at this table. One seat per account: carry on from that seat, or leave it first.
errors.roomUnavailable: No open table with that code. Check the code; the table may also be full or over.
errors.serverFull: The game server is full right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.tableCap: You already have the most tables open. Finish or leave one of them first.
errors.notController: Only the player who opened the table, or a club admin, can add bots or start the match.
